description: This file defines internal static class NetworkingInstruments which contains metrics counters for tracking opened and closed network sockets, including methods to update these counters based on socket connection events.

classes.name: NetworkingInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing metrics counters for network socket events, such as opening and closing sockets.

methods.name: OnOpenedSocket
methods.description: Increments the counter for opened sockets, tagging the connection direction.

methods.name: OnClosedSocket
methods.description: Increments the counter for closed sockets, tagging the connection direction.
